excerpt:
一个实现途径是将已有分布作为先验，构造价值加权目标：

\[
q^\*(a\mid s)
\propto
q_{\mathrm{prior}}(a\mid s)
\exp\left(\frac{\widehat Q(s,a)}{\eta}\right).
\]

它对应一个局部优化问题：

\[
\max_q
\left\{
\mathbb E_{a\sim q}[\widehat Q(s,a)]
-
\eta\,\mathrm{KL}(q\|q_{\mathrm{prior}})
\right\}.
\]
ending: The remainder of this long answer discusses execution budgets and experimental controls.
